title: Formal Artifact axe pass found low-contrast eyebrow text and nested interactive semantics in the SVG map
tool: Artifact pinned Playwright 1.63.0 / Chromium 153 / axe-core Playwright 4.13.0
workflow: self-contained interactive carrier -> Artifact browser/axe verifier
symptom: axe reported 2 violation classes: color-contrast on BOUNDARY/ROUTES eyebrow labels (4.11:1, required 4.5:1) and nested-interactive because role=img SVG contained keyboard-focusable work nodes.
expected_behavior: The standalone carrier should preserve keyboard interaction while passing the mature automated accessibility gate.
actual_behavior: Visual review and functional keyboard tests passed, but the stronger formal accessibility consumer falsified two semantics/style choices.
proposed_fix: Raise shared dim-text contrast and change the map container from an image role to a labelled non-interactive group while leaving individual work nodes keyboard-focusable.
fix_attempt: Changed --dim from #6e7681 to #7d8590 and svg role from img to group; standalone carrier rebuilt for repeat Artifact verification.
verification: Repeat mature Artifact gate PASS: Chromium 153.0.8010.12 + axe-core Playwright 4.13.0 reported 0 violations; Firefox 155.0 launched PASS; WebKit remains NOT_INSTALLED on this local Arch target and is not promoted.
